description: baseline one-pass structured extraction
finding: Large recall gap led by names and email with concentrated misses in dense lists

description: gated grounded extraction with correspondence output-cap failure
finding: Partial result improved quality on 121 documents but cannot rank with one failed document

description: bounded fallback for output-capped correspondence
finding: Representative score improved substantially with all documents complete

description: incumbent small-set comparator
finding: Short PII-dense documents are near target with four phone misses and one name miss

description: incumbent long-tail comparator
finding: Selected long-document mix is near target; broad random sample drives the remaining gap

description: remove names found only inside email addresses
finding: Precision rose but recall loss reduced the representative score

description: filter explicit organization name records
finding: Small deterministic precision gain did not overcome lower model recall

description: compact names-only recovery for dense short documents
finding: Recall held but one negative document gained sixteen false-positive name fields

description: gate compact dense-name recovery on primary people
finding: Removed the negative-document regression and passed the promotion gate

description: guarded compact recovery on broad document mix
finding: Recovered dense-list names but added false positives; variance could change the decision

description: confirmation of guarded compact dense-name recovery
finding: Second broad-sample run confirmed unstable false positives and a lower score

description: recover every missing literal email as an email-only person
finding: Recall held but placeholder aliases and OCR variants added nine false positives

description: filter placeholder group and substring email variants
finding: Reduced email false positives from nine to two; separator aliases remained

description: normalize separator-only recovered email aliases
finding: Unrelated name false positives and doubled output cost indicate a variance outlier

description: filtered literal email recovery on broad document mix
finding: Recovered six email true positives but added six email false positives; overall score was competitive

description: confirmation of filtered literal email recovery
finding: Email recall improved again but combined representative scores remained below incumbent

description: preserve fax direct-dial and weekday-labeled phones
finding: Recovered three phone true positives with no false positives and met both targets

description: preserve labeled secondary phones on long-tail mix
finding: Recovered three phone true positives with no false positives and improved the comparator

description: preserve labeled secondary phones on broad document mix
finding: Recovered four phone true positives; unrelated model variance left overall score competitive

description: confirmation of preserving labeled secondary phones
finding: Severe variance outlier erased the field gain and confirmed unstable representative evidence

description: fixed seed 42 reproducibility run one
finding: First seeded run exactly reproduced the incumbent small-set score

description: fixed seed 42 reproducibility run two
finding: Repeat differed by one phone true positive but remained high precision and close in score

description: fixed seed 42 long-tail reproducibility run one
finding: First seeded long-tail run exceeded the incumbent comparator with one email false positive

description: fixed seed 42 long-tail reproducibility run two
finding: Repeat stayed close with perfect precision and minor recall variation

description: fixed seed 42 representative reproducibility run one
finding: All documents completed but incomplete provider metering made the aggregate score non-final

description: fixed seed 42 representative reproducibility run two
finding: Complete confirmation fell below the incumbent and retained dominant name and email omissions

description: recover authors from dense numbered citation tables
finding: Strict deterministic parsing removed the largest name-recall cluster and set a new representative best

description: citation-table recovery on PII-dense subset
finding: Strict routing left ordinary documents precise and retained a high subset score

description: citation-table recovery on long-tail subset
finding: Strict routing preserved perfect precision across the long-tail subset

description: preserve labeled phones with citation-table incumbent
finding: Recovered one phone true positive with no precision loss and improved the subset score

description: preserve labeled phones on long-tail subset
finding: Recovered two phone true positives without false positives while unrelated field variance offset the aggregate gain

description: preserve labeled phones on representative mix
finding: One dense citation document exceeded the output cap inside fallback chunking

description: use smaller chunks for dense fallback responses
finding: Dense fallback completed but its latency caused another document to miss the dataset deadline

description: route dense citation tables deterministically
finding: Zero-call citation routing removed overflow failures and set a new quality and cost best

description: recover bracketed nonstandard email values
finding: A distribution-list header added three linked false-positive fields and required an organization guard

description: exclude organization addresses from named header recovery
finding: The guard removed all linked false positives and restored perfect precision

description: guarded named-header recovery on representative mix
finding: Recovered eleven email true positives but unrelated field variance left the total score just below the incumbent

description: confirmation of guarded named-header recovery
finding: Repeat set a new representative best and confirmed the material email-recall gain

description: second confirmation of guarded named-header recovery
finding: Third complete result stayed above the prior incumbent and reached the candidate's highest precision

description: final confirmation of guarded named-header recovery
finding: Four-run representative average remained above the prior incumbent with consistent email-recall gains
